title: Add request's referrer policy restriction
body:
Adds a request's referrer policy restriction, a mechanism to restrict the referrer policy (after the policy container fallback). Unlike the referrer policy, it can only make the policy stricter. This is placed in the Fetch Standard so that callers (starting with CSS `url()` `referrer-policy()`, see https://github.com/w3c/csswg-drafts/issues/14872) can uniformly restrict a request's referrer policy rather than relying on each caller to compute a restricted policy. Companion PRs: - Referrer Policy ("restrict a referrer policy"): https://github.com/w3c/webappsec-referrer-policy/pull/180 (alternative: https://github.com/w3c/webappsec-referrer-policy/pull/181) - CSS Values 5 (`referrer-policy()` modifier): https://github.com/w3c/csswg-drafts/pull/14873 *(Note: the `TEMP` commit adds a temporary `
` entry for "restrict a referrer policy" so Bikeshed CI and PR Preview stay green; drop that commit after the Referrer Policy PR lands and spec-data updates.)*
